minutes_text:
Minutes of City Council
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF
THE CITY COUNCILOF THE CITY OF CALABASAS,
CALIFORNIA, HELD WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 10, 2008
OPENING MATTERS
Call to Order/Roll Call of Councilmembers
Pledge of Allegiance
Approval of Agenda
Recognition of 2009 Recycling Calendar Coloring Contest Winners
ANNOUNCEMENTS/INTRODUCTIONS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - PUBLIC COMMENT
CONSENT ITEMS
1. Approval of the minutes for the November 12, 2008 City Council meeting.
2. Adoption of Ordinance No. 2008-249, modifying Chapter 17.76.030 of the Municipal Code to restrict parking of recreational vehicles on private property.
3. Adoption of Ordinance No. 2008-250, restricting the parking of recreational vehicles on public streets.
4. Recommendation to approve a professional services agreement with Mark IV Consulting, Inc. in the amount of $50,000.
5. Recommendation to accept completion for the Annual Rubberized Asphalt Overlay 2007-08, Specification No. 06-07-14 by Sully-Miller Contracting, Inc.; and to direct the City Clerk to file the notice of completion.
6. Adoption of Resolution No. 2008-1164, accepting Proposition 1B Funding from the State of California for the 2009 street resurfacing project; and approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Pavement Engineer's, Inc. for engineering design and project management services.
7. Adoption of Resolution No. 2008-1165, supporting the Dry Canyon Creek Historic Meander Restoration Project and approving the co-sponsorship with the Mountains Restoration Trust of a joint application for grant funding.
8. Recommendation to amend a contract with Advanced Construction & Restoration for sign and sign post installation services from $150,000 to $300,000.
9. Adoption of Resolution No. 2008-1159, certifying an Environmental Impact Report as being adequate and conformant to the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act and the CEQA guidelines, and approving File No. 080000815, amending the General Plan for the City of Calabasas by adopting the 2030 General Plan Update.
10. Request by Councilmembers Groveman and Wolfson to discuss expansion of the City’s Rental Assistance program and a temporary increase in the monthly subsidy provided through the program.
11. Check Register for the period of November 6, 2008 to November 21, 2008.
TASK FORCE REPORTS
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
ADJOURN
Respectfully submitted:
Gwen Peirce
Assistant City Clerk
